card.headline: Did you know there are better words than *"very pretty"*?

beats.speech: Did you know there are better words than very pretty? Here are three.
Gorgeous: Mia watches the sunset. The sunset is gorgeous.
Stunning: Next, she sees a dress. It looks stunning.
Lovely: Her friend brings flowers. The flowers are lovely.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!

language_approval.notes: All 5 beats natural B1 English; speech matches card text (3/three only); gorgeous/stunning/lovely used in correct collocations (sunset, dress, flowers); caps OK; no policy issues. No edits.
